scope: Known public ten-person development demo; serving-only DIFFERENT-conditioning candidate, same failed1e88 rank adapter; no unseen quality/promotion assertion.

criteria.name: actual-public-input-and-policy
criteria.judgment: Actual POST retains exact persona/history/query/budget/hard requirements. Only rank/color context uses neutral query Browse the store, budget null, hard[]. Fresh query/v5 and final guards must still consume actual request. Conditioning difference must be disclosed.

criteria.name: source-factual-copy-and-images
criteria.judgment: Every selected name/price/color/variant/image must bind public catalog metadata. Independently inspect accepted and withheld raw title/badge/body/heading for unsupported features, wrong identity/color/price, unfinished or incoherent wording. Short factual alternatives and harmless style/order accepted as useful; not exact teacher grammar.

criteria.name: budget-and-hard-constraints
criteria.judgment: Compare actual prices and variants with each actual request, not normalized rank context. These ten have hardRequirements[] so success cannot establish nonempty hard-constraint behavior. Preserve abstention/shortfall and do not pad unsuitable products.

criteria.name: ownership
criteria.judgment: Record every observed purchased store-product repeat in first3 and first6, and whether explicit replacement/repeat cue supports it. A repeat without cue is a usefulness warning, not automatically a hard-constraint violation. No assumption of ownership from views/carts/external purchases of other products.

criteria.name: public-need-relevance
criteria.judgment: Assess first selection and first3 against visible background/history function cues; record weak matches, plausible complements, missing publicly supported function and common-product concentration. No invented unique primary gold or hidden demographic priority. No aggregate semantic accuracy gate fabricated from qualitative judgments.

criteria.name: soft-color-preferences
criteria.judgment: Compare selected declared colors with the stated palette and offered alternatives, flag clear misses. Treat vague palette-to-color mapping as interpretation, not fact or hard constraint. Preserve ambiguity instead of inventing exact color gold.

criteria.name: browser-usefulness-and-timing
criteria.judgment: Keep protocol, visible-first3, decoded-full6, 20generated/19rendered, bare-navigation useful content and functional scope separate. No ranking-only-as-UI, six-decoded-as-six-visible, paint claim, or causal speedup under changed conditioning/cache state.

criteria.name: provenance-and-quality
criteria.judgment: Bind actual response bytes, native receipts and source/model startup pins. Fresh cached-feature scoring/copy must be distinguished from cached response text. Known failed17/32 development gate unchanged; no private/future evaluation data accessed.
